meta.title: Relocating from Toronto to Ottawa | Lépine Apartments
meta.description: Trade the 401 gridlock for the scenic Ottawa Valley. Escape the congestion of Brampton, Mississauga, and Toronto for luxury, resort-style rental apartments in Ottawa, Kanata, Renfrew, and Smiths Falls.

hero.header: Trade the GTA Grind for National Capital Relaxation
hero.copy: Stop spending your life stuck on the GO Train or the 401. Upgrade to resort-style luxury, lower maintenance costs, and a lifestyle that reclaims your time.

intro.header: Why Leave the GTA for Lépine?
intro.copy:
You’ve survived the daily grind of the QEW and the 427 crush. You know the frustration of commuting in from Brampton, Barrie or Newmarket into the core. It’s time to stop defining your day by GO Train delays and Union Station crowds.

Moving to the Ottawa area offers relief from the endless sprawl of the Golden Horseshoe. Here, you can live in a world-class city with a fraction of the congestion. Whether you are a remote worker escaping a condo in Liberty Village, or a retiree cashing out of a detached home in Mississauga, Lépine Apartments offers a seamless transition to a calmer, more connected life.

locationAdvantage.copy: Lépine communities are strategically located to keep you connected to major North American and International hubs while removing you from the daily noise of the GTA.

lifestyle.copy:
In the GTA, homeownership often means spending your weekends fighting traffic to get to the cottage or maintaining a property in a sprawling suburb like Brampton or Newmarket. At Lépine, we believe your home should be a sanctuary, not a burden.

Swap the DVP traffic reports for a round of golf or a paddle on the Rideau River. Our 'lighter living' philosophy means you are free from property taxes, snow removal, and the 'always-on' rush of Toronto life.
